title: Middle Eastern Mezze Board
seo_title: Mezze Platter for 8–14: Hummus, Halloumi & Shopping List
description: A Middle Eastern mezze board for 8–14: grilled halloumi, feta, hummus, baba ganoush, tzatziki, muhammara, lamb meatballs, merguez, olives and warm pita.
hook: Hummus at the center, warm spices all around: a communal mezze spread with four dips and grilled halloumi.
why: Four dips cover four flavors, which keeps a mezze board from tasting like one long note: earthy hummus, smoky baba ganoush, cool tzatziki and sweet-hot muhammara. Warm pita goes out first.
Halloumi grills instead of melting, so it can be served warm and golden, and briny feta with olive oil and za'atar is the cold contrast. Lamb meatballs and merguez make it a meal.

timeline.what: Grill the halloumi; warm the pita; set out the dips.
Slice the merguez; prep the garnishes.
Set the four dip bowls at the center.
Add the halloumi, meats, fruit and pita.

faq.q: What is on a mezze platter?
faq.a: Dips like hummus, baba ganoush, tzatziki and muhammara, feta and halloumi, olives, vegetables, dates, meatballs or sausages, za'atar and pita.
Slice it ½ inch thick and cook in a hot dry pan or on a grill for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden. Serve warm.
Yes. Leave out the meatballs and merguez and add falafel or extra halloumi.
